title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 34 part 1
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual translation pilots.

Status at a glance. Numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited, with the Paper 34 product-table restoration preserved. Multilingual stream: Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers are complete through Paper 34 part 1; Paper 01 French and complete Paper 02 French pilots are also included. Source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, build logs, render checks, and glossary/methodology deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Adds Spanish and Japanese cumulative readers through Paper 34 part 1, standalone Paper 34 part 1 Spanish/Japanese readers, and the source/witness ZIP for the multilingual continuation. This package also carries a Paper 33 terminology refinement for the historical noncommutative Körper context.
